title: AcademicSequenceRecord
description: Schema for individual semester academic observations for a student

semester_index.description: Ordered semester sequence number (1 = Year 1 Sem 1, up to 8)

gpa.description: Grade Point Average for the specific semester

exam_mark_avg.description: Average examination mark across enrolled modules (%)

attendance_rate.description: Percentage of lecture and tutorial sessions attended (%)

submission_delay_avg_days.description: Average delay in assignment submission beyond deadline (days)

attrition_label.description: Ground truth attrition outcome (1 = Dropped out / Terminated, 0 = Persisted)

is_synthetic.description: Strict provenance flag indicating if the record is synthetically generated
